wall: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art architectural sprite atlas for a Tibia 7.6 map. Edit the reference atlas: replace ONLY the beige timber/plaster material with ancient cold grey-green crypt stone, thick intertwined dark brown roots, restrained moss, tiny amber fungal flecks. Keep EXACTLY the same atlas structure: 3 columns by 2 rows, six separate cells, all same square dimensions. Top row: a wall starting post, horizontal wall, vertical wall. Bottom row: southeast L corner, horizontal small barred window wall, vertical small barred window wall. Reference is a geometry template, preserve each piece's alignment, base edges, orthographic Tibia oblique projection and outer silhouette exactly. Windows must be dark small apertures within stone, no timber. Texture should be chunky, high contrast, clean pixel art readable when the entire atlas is reduced to 192x128, each cell64x64. Green moss on joints, roots follow stone surfaces and do not extend outside the geometry. No cyan, no neon, no glowing lines, no characters, floor, captions, labels, gridlines, or shadows outside the object. Actual transparent background, isolated sprites, no contact sheet padding between cells. The top and bottom of each cell must align to the reference.
